close_reason: Created tests/common/mod.rs (MemoryBackend: full HashMap impl with state tracking, change log, query filter, JSON merge-patch); 1 roundtrip integration test; clippy clean
description:
**What:** Create crate-jmap-sharing-server/tests/common/mod.rs with a full MemoryBackend implementing SharingBackend. Backed by HashMaps. Actually stores and retrieves objects, tracks state, records change log.

**Internal structure:**
- objects: HashMap<(&'static str, String), HashMap<Id, serde_json::Value>> keyed by (type_name, account_id)
- states: HashMap<(&'static str, String), u64>
- change_log: per (type_name, account_id): Vec<ChangeEntry { new_state, created, updated, destroyed }>
- known_accounts: HashSet<String>
- pub fn new_with_accounts(ids: &[&str]) -> Self

**JmapBackend impl:**
- account_exists: checks known_accounts
- get_objects: fetch by ids (or all), deserialize Value → O
- get_state: returns state counter as string
- get_changes: walks change log from since_state; returns CannotCalculateChanges if not in log
- query_objects: fetch all, apply filter; implement Principal filter (RFC 9670 §2.4.1: accountIds, email, name, text, type, timeZone) and ShareNotification filter (§3.4.1: after, before, objectType, objectAccountId); sort ShareNotification by created
- query_changes: from change log

**SharingBackend impl:**
- create_object: assign new Id, set id field in stored JSON to new Id, store, bump state, log
- update_object: JSON merge-patch, reserialize, store, bump state
- destroy_object: remove, bump state, log
- supports_type: true for all

**Acceptance criteria:**
- Round-trip test: create Principal via create_object, then get_objects with returned id → same object.
- get_changes from state "0" after one create → created: [new_id].
- cargo test -p jmap-sharing-server exits 0.
title: Add MemoryBackend for integration tests
